description: Append the operations from another spec to an already-generated project (identified by its .mcp-translator.json manifest). Idempotent: operations already present are skipped, and hand-edited tool files are preserved unless force is set. Enables aggregating multiple APIs into one MCP server.

auth.description: Auth to use when the spec declares no security schemes of its own. Applied only to operations whose own security list is empty; credentials are read from env vars as usual.

excludeOperations.description: Drop operations by operationId, tool name, or tag.

force.description: Overwrite existing tool files of the same name.

format.description: Force a format; defaults to auto-detect.

includeTags.description: Keep only operations with these tags.

methods.description: Keep only these HTTP methods, e.g. [GET, POST].

projectDir.description: Path to an existing generated project.

spec.description: Inline spec text (OpenAPI or Postman; JSON or YAML).

specPath.description: Path to a local spec file (JSON or YAML).

toolCatalog.description: Also write tool-catalog.json; defaults to refreshing it if the project has one.

name: extend_mcp_server
title: Extend an existing generated MCP server
